title: Fury of the Sunwell — WoW Timeline Chapter 14
notes:
Accessed 2026-10-03. Official Blizzard summary: after defeat in Outland Kael'thas returns to Silvermoon and plots to use the Sunwell to summon Kil'jaeden; the joint Shattered Sun Offensive and Horde/Alliance heroes stop them, and Velen helps purify the well. The page header incorrectly calls Fury of the Sunwell patch 2.3. Other 2.4 evidence is stronger; preserve, do not silently correct, the source discrepancy.
